scientific_integrity: The theorem has an explicit integral local-to-global proof and reproducible finite checks. No independent mathematical assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The prime \(2\), modulus \(p^k\) for \(k\ge3\), and restricted index sets are excluded; finite exact checks supplement but do not establish the universal proof; historical-priority risk remains from general Smith-form methods.
scope: Every odd prime \(p\) and integer exponent \(a\ge1\), all residue indices modulo \(p^2\); complete integral Smith factors.
title: Complete Smith factors of cyclic power-GCD matrices at odd prime-square order
